symptom: PLAN remained EMPTY because the deterministic plan serializer rejected the semantic target as src/cli.mjs\, even though the model intended a Markdown code-span closing delimiter and the physical target was src/cli.mjs.
evidence: The live harness completed with command exit codes containing producer failure, and the final assistant message reported: semantic physical implementation target must be a normalized repository-relative path: src/cli.mjs\. No plan artifacts were published; official readback stayed EMPTY and the driver returned OFFICIAL_TRANSITION_NOT_OBSERVED.
rootCause: The planner producer treated a model-escaped closing Markdown fence in a path-only code span as a literal trailing backslash in the semantic physical target. The existing strict semantic path authority correctly rejected backslashes, but the producer lacked the narrow delimiter normalization boundary.
responsibleBoundary: stnl-execution-planner runtime/serialize-plan-paths.mjs code-span extraction before semantic target resolution
correction: Normalize only one trailing backslash in a path-only code span when it is the escaped closing-fence marker; preserve interior backslashes so the existing semantic path authority still blocks malformed paths. Serialize canonical artifact-relative claims before candidate validation and publication.
whyCodeVsPrompt: The boundary is Markdown delimiter parsing plus deterministic path-carrier normalization. A prompt-only prohibition cannot reliably prevent the model from escaping a code-span delimiter.
regression: scripts/test-execution-contract.mjs: escaped closing-fence carrier serializes to the canonical physical target and strict validation then passes; malformed path-basis input remains rejected.
localValidation: Focused execution contract passed after the regression was added.
liveReplay: Fresh A stopped legally at PLAN before publication; B and C were gated. Replay is diagnostic and cannot count as final because it predates this correction.
workflowProgress: SPEC_INIT passed; PLAN reached producer boundary and exposed a distinct delimiter-format blocker with outer retry 0.
